message: You know, there's nothing quite like a storm to remind us how much we rely on our phones. Just when you need a little information or reassurance, your battery decides it's time to take a nap. 🌧️ That’s why I find it helpful to have a good old-fashioned plan in place before the skies get gray. A little preparation goes a long way in ensuring we're ready, even if the tech is playing coy. What’s your go-to tip for stormy days?
